sourceFile: 66.1 BRS-161014  Report Summary data test improve NG separate VP+CD 2024.09.17_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but incorrectly merges separate LED UV, VP thickness, glue, bond-line, and CD press jig tests into one changed factor.
issues: Multiple independent tests are combined under one changed factor.
Function NG pairing crosses line subgroup and omits the matching E2 normal row.
VP thickness min/max is a separate changed factor, not part of LED UV baseline.
CD press jig OK vs worn is a separate comparison with equal zero NG, not a LED UV changed condition.
Glue/bond-line sections are incomplete or not represented with valid comparable outcomes.
correctionPlan: Split review into separate changed-factor contexts for LED UV peak, VP thickness, CD press jig, and any citeable glue or bond-line test.
For LED UV, pair C2-3A test row 25 with normal row 26 and E2-3B test row 27 with normal row 28.
Keep line and date as subgroup keys for tension and function outcomes.
Rejudge CD press jig as no difference using rows 81 and 82 only.
Exclude or flag glue and bond-line results unless comparable cited result rows are available.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until comparisons preserve test context and subgroup keys.
